new.s: When was GSAT-30 launched from Kourou, French Guiana?
new.x: GSAT-30, a telecom satellite, went up from Kourou on 17 January 2020. 21 May 2011 was GSAT-8 and 6 February 2019 was GSAT-31.
new.angle: U0727 #1 INSAT/GSAT -> launch date (PYQ GSAT-8 date angle)

new.s: In which year was GSAT-11, the heaviest ISRO-built satellite, launched?
new.x: GSAT-11 (about 5.8 t), the heaviest satellite built by ISRO, was launched from abroad in 2018.

new.s: Which satellite replaced INSAT-4C, which was lost in the GSLV-F02 failure of 10 July 2006?
new.x: After INSAT-4C was lost on GSLV-F02, ISRO launched INSAT-4CR in September 2007 on GSLV-F04.

new.s: High-throughput satellites such as GSAT-19, GSAT-29 and GSAT-11 support which programme?
new.x: The high-throughput Ka-band satellites GSAT-19, -29, -11 and N2 provide broadband capacity that supports BharatNet.

new.s: Elena Geo Systems is known for which of the following?
o: Supplying rubidium clocks for IRNSS satellites
Making Snapdragon chipsets that support NavIC
new.x: Elena Geo Systems made India's first NavIC-based device, used for precise directions on infrastructure projects.

new.s: What is the full form of IRNSS, the earlier name of NavIC?
o: Integrated Regional Navigation and Surveillance System
Indian Range and Navigation Satellite System
new.x: IRNSS stands for Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System; it was renamed NavIC (Navigation with Indian Constellation).

new.s: In which year was the GPS programme begun?
new.x: GPS (Global Positioning System) of the US Department of Defense was begun in 1973; its first satellite flew in 1978.

new.s: Which of the following global navigation satellite systems is under civilian control?
new.x: Galileo of the European Union, live since 2016, is under civilian control and works with GPS and GLONASS.
new.angle: U0728 #1 GNSS -> owner (notes gap: Galileo civilian control)

new.s: Which of the following has the shortest wavelength?
new.x: In the electromagnetic spectrum, wavelength falls from infrared to visible to ultraviolet to gamma rays, so gamma rays have the shortest wavelength.

new.s: Which sensor detected 52,785 forest fires in India between November 2020 and June 2021?
new.x: MODIS (Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectro-radiometer) detected 52,785 forest fires in the 2020-21 fire season.
new.angle: U0729 #6 technique -> what it maps (PYQ MODIS angle)

new.s: In remote sensing, what does temporal resolution refer to?
o: The smallest object a sensor can see
The number and width of spectral bands
How often a satellite revisits the same place
The sensitivity to small differences in energy
new.x: Temporal resolution is the revisit time of a satellite over one place; the other three describe spatial, spectral and radiometric resolution.

new.s: In which year was Cartosat-1, India's first mapping satellite, launched?
new.x: Cartosat-1, India's first mapping satellite with stereo imaging, was launched in 2005; Cartosat-3 came in 2019.

new.s: What is the approximate resolution of Cartosat-3?
new.x: Cartosat-3 (November 2019, PSLV-C47) has a resolution of about 25 cm.

new.s: Which launch vehicle placed the Rohini satellite in orbit in 1980?
new.x: Rohini was launched in 1980 on India's SLV-3, which is a launch vehicle, not a satellite.
new.angle: U0729 #1 early IRS/EO satellites -> launcher (notes gap)

new.s: Which launch vehicle launched DS-SAR, a radar satellite, in July 2023?
new.x: DS-SAR flew on PSLV-C56; PSLV-C57 carried Aditya-L1 and PSLV-C58 carried XPoSat.

new.s: What service is BlueBird Block-2, launched by LVM3-M6 in December 2025, meant to provide?
new.x: BlueBird Block-2 of AST SpaceMobile (USA), with a 223 sq m antenna, gives direct-to-smartphone broadband.
new.angle: U0730 #4 foreign customer satellite -> purpose (notes gap)

new.s: Which was the first student satellite launched by ISRO?
new.x: ANUSAT (2009), built by Anna University, was the first student satellite launched by ISRO.

new.s: AGILE, the Italian satellite launched by PSLV-C8 in April 2007, was meant for which field?
new.x: AGILE was an Italian gamma-ray astronomy satellite launched commercially on PSLV-C8 in 2007.
new.angle: U0730 #4 foreign customer satellites (PYQ AGILE angle, other direction)

new.s: Along with the Vikram lander and the Pragyan rover, which was the third part of Chandrayaan-3?
new.x: Chandrayaan-3 had a Propulsion Module, the Vikram lander and the Pragyan rover; it had no orbiter of its own.
new.angle: U0731 #10 Chandrayaan module names (PYQ names angle)

new.s: What were the names of the lander and the rover of Chandrayaan-2?
new.x: Chandrayaan-2 carried the lander Vikram and the rover Pragyan; Chandrayaan-3 kept the same names.
new.angle: U0731 #10 Chandrayaan module names (PYQ names angle)

new.s: Which countries soft-landed on the Moon before India's Chandrayaan-3?

new.angle: U0731 #11 India's rank among soft-landing nations

new.s: What is the name of the landing site of Chandrayaan-3's Vikram lander?
new.x: Vikram landed on 23 August 2023 at Shiv Shakti Point; Tiranga Point is Chandrayaan-2's crash site and Jawahar Point is Chandrayaan-1's impact site.

new.s: With which space agency is India planning the LUPEX (Chandrayaan-5) mission?
new.x: LUPEX (Chandrayaan-5) is a joint lunar south pole water-ice mission of ISRO and Japan's JAXA.

new.s: Which was China's first lunar sample-return mission (2020)?
new.x: Chang'e-5 (2020) was China's first lunar sample return, the first since Soviet Luna 24 (1976).
new.angle: U0731 #13 Chang'e series FIRSTs (PYQ Chang'e-5 angle)

new.s: Kalpana Chawla died when which space shuttle broke up on 1 February 2003?
new.x: Space shuttle Columbia broke up over Texas on 1 February 2003, killing all its crew including Kalpana Chawla.
new.angle: U0731 #7 space shuttle missions (PYQ Columbia/Kalpana Chawla angle)

new.s: Which launch vehicle launched Chandrayaan-1 on 22 October 2008?
new.x: Chandrayaan-1 flew on PSLV-C11; PSLV-C25 carried Mangalyaan and PSLV-C30 carried AstroSat.

new.s: Which country was originally to supply the lander for Chandrayaan-2?
new.x: Russia's Roscosmos was to supply the lander but withdrew after 2013, so ISRO built Vikram itself.

new.s: Which of the following was a payload of Mangalyaan?
new.x: Mangalyaan carried 5 payloads, including the Methane Sensor for Mars; M3 was on Chandrayaan-1, VELC on Aditya-L1 and APXS on Chandrayaan-3.

new.s: By which country's rocket was Aryabhata, India's first satellite, launched in 1975?
new.x: Aryabhata, India's first satellite, was launched in 1975 on a Soviet rocket.

new.s: What is the name of JAXA's next-generation rocket that replaced the H-IIA and had its first success on 17 February 2024?

new.s: Peggy Whitson, commander of the Axiom-4 mission, holds which record?
o: Longest single flight by a NASA astronaut
First woman to walk on the Moon
new.x: Peggy Whitson holds the record for most spacewalks by a woman and the US record for cumulative days in space.
new.angle: U0732 #11 Axiom-4 crew / astronaut records (PYQ spacewalks angle)

new.s: If Gaganyaan's crewed flight succeeds, India will become which country to send humans into space on its own?
new.x: Only the USSR, the USA and China have launched humans on their own, so India would be the fourth.
new.angle: U0732 #17 countries with own human spaceflight (notes gap)

new.s: Where is ISRO's new SSLV launch complex, whose foundation was laid on 27 August 2025, located?
new.x: The SSLV launch complex is coming up at Kulasekarapattinam in Tamil Nadu; its foundation was laid on 27 August 2025.

new.s: Who was China's first astronaut, flown on Shenzhou-5 in October 2003?
new.x: Yang Liwei flew on Shenzhou-5 on 15 October 2003, making China the 3rd country to launch a human, after the USSR and USA.
